author: pgaudet
body:
Dear all, 

The proposal has been made to obsolete 
GO:0046496 nicotinamide nucleotide metabolic process and 
GO:0019359 nicotinamide nucleotide biosynthetic process

see https://github.com/geneontology/go-ontology/issues/32583

The reason for obsoletion is that these are unnecessary grouping classes. There are 4 manual annotations to this term: 
- 3 SGD
- 1 UniProt (changed) 
- 2 Unirules
- 2 HAMAP 

Suggested replacements are in the spreadsheet : 
https://docs.google.com/spreadsheets/d/1l58pju_HNf2QpDxm0b6b6MWChRnFX8vATzsh0IlhOqw/edit?gid=0#gid=0

Thanks, Pascale
